head: 4f7f59718e29240225ab65a3f6d3ab6915e97057
summary: commands_env passes GITHUB_ENV, GITHUB_PATH and GITHUB_OUTPUT through to the unsandboxed targets, so a session-written test can append PYTHONPATH or a PATH entry pointing into the checkout and get its own code run by the job's later steps (Verify the project checkout, Park, Publish the explanation), which hold the App token.
